sloka: ततः पार्श्वगतं दृष्ट्वा सविमर्शं विचारयन् ।विभीषणमिदं वाक्यमहृष्टं राघवो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ६.११७.१७ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pārśvagataṁ dṛṣṭvā savimarśaṁ vicārayan ।vibhīṣaṇamidaṁ vākyamahṛṣṭaṁ rāghavo 'bravīt ।। 6.117.17 ।।

translations.english: On hearing that Sita had arrived, who stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, Raghava had experienced joy, indignation, and anger, all the three at the same time.
